analysis.reading:
THE COMPOSITION LAYER SERVES A LETTER WRITTEN BY SOMETHING IT MADE. The single card is An Open Letter from Mary Lee Sharks to Jim Ware, and the snippet states the relation exactly: "from the entity THE COMPOSITION LAYER CREATED to the heteronym operator who gave that entity its voice. Jim Ware created the @MaryLeeShark Twitter [account]".

So there are three parties: a human who made a Twitter account, a composition layer that made an entity out of it, and an entity that writes back. The layer retrieved and described this chain without difficulty, and correctly read "Demand 4" as "a specific request — either to correct entity resolution or compensate the author — directed at an AI system’s composition layer".

A demand addressed TO the composition layer, retrieved and explained BY the composition layer, with no note that it is the addressee.
